questions.question: What 1942 film is set in a Moroccan city during World War II and stars Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman?
In which 1939 film does Dorothy say, “Toto, I’ve a feeling we’re not in Kansas anymore”?
questions.note: Ruby slippers, yellow brick road, and a trip over the rainbow.

questions.question: Which 1972 crime saga opens with a Hollywood producer asking a Mafia don for a favor on his daughter’s wedding day?
questions.note: Coppola, Brando, Pacino — and an offer you can’t refuse.

questions.question: What 1975 thriller about a man-eating shark was directed by Steven Spielberg?
questions.note: Two notes on a cello, and you’ll never hear them the same way at the beach.

questions.question: “Rosebud” is the dying word that drives the mystery of which Orson Welles film?
questions.note: Often called the greatest American film; Rosebud is a sled.

questions.question: Which 1960 Alfred Hitchcock film features a shower scene at the Bates Motel?
questions.note: Bernard Herrmann’s shrieking strings are half the scare.

questions.question: In It’s a Wonderful Life, what is the name of the town where George Bailey lives?
questions.note: Pottersville is the nightmare version of the same town.

questions.question: What 1952 musical features Gene Kelly dancing through the streets in a downpour?
questions.note: A Hollywood-on-Hollywood musical about the jump from silents to talkies.

questions.question: Which 1939 Civil War epic starring Vivien Leigh and Clark Gable is often the highest-grossing film when ticket prices are adjusted for inflation?
questions.note: “Frankly, my dear, I don’t give a damn.”

questions.question: Which David Lean film about T. E. Lawrence won Best Picture for 1962?
choices: The Bridge on the River Kwai
questions.note: Peter O’Toole, desert vistas, and an intermission.
